Name: Izrahiah
Summary: Son of Uzzi and father of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Ishiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:3: Son of Uzzi and father of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Ishiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Izrahiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
